messages:
emma: Late-night brainwave  who has recs for weird 90s basement mixtapes + arthouse foreign films? trying to craft a vibe for rainy saturday.
jared: Ooh. For mixtapes, dig into Hesitation Wounds indie comps and some early post-rock (Loom, early Mogwai) for crescendos.
sophia: foreign films: 'A Fantastic Woman' (Chile) is quiet and raw; 'Woman at War' is more deadpan. both pair strangely well with guitar swells.
kai: throw in some darkwave synth (Minimal Wave comps) in the middle of the mix to reset mood.
emma: @mix-bot any quick playlist matches?
mix-bot: Match suggestion: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6example (90s alt + darkwave + post-rock) :headphones:
vincent: if you want something shorter and punchier, watch 'The Bothersome Man' (Norway) for a weird, dry bite between tracks.
jared: love that. idea: start with acoustic slowburners, hit a darkwave interlude, then close with a cinematic post-rock finish.
sophia: for bookish interlude, a 20-min excerpt from Bolaf1ob9s short stories would keep tone. (i have a reading file i can share)
kai: @emma your rainy saturday plan sounds perfect. when you throw the playlist together, ping me and i'll add a grainy film loop for background.
emma: will do. thinking 2hr set, projector on, low lights. who wants to drop into the mini-gathering saturday 8pm?
jared: in. bringing thermos and a dumb lamp.
vincent: RSVP: yes. will cue 'Bolaf1o' excerpt.
mix-bot: Event created: "Basement Mix & Arthouse" 1754385600 (Sat 8pm local). Reminder set 1754382000 (1 hour prior).
emma: perfect. thanks team, this thread just planned my whole weekend :grin:
sophia: same. bonus points if we get board games afterwards.
kai: I can bring a travel chess set.
emma: epic. see you saturday!
